scope: Representative overview sources, product-oriented replies, precise citation presentation, unified revision details and honest inspection limits

regressions.retrieval: Go/Python/TypeScript entry-call fixtures require actual implementation and reject a decoy containing the old query. Native overview intent filters literal-only candidates before exposing navigation context; ordinary index intents are unchanged.
regressions.context_bounds: At most four overview candidates and two additional file reads; no repeat of delivered current-turn sources. Manifest header is six lines unless dependency information is requested. Index result budget is at most 6000 bytes inside the existing tool budget.
regressions.response: Overview guidance prioritizes documented project identity, purpose, capabilities, components and explicit inspection limits, including during citation correction.
regressions.citations: Exact displayed duplicates are omitted. A broad selected source is omitted only when present in the inspected request-scoped choices and already covered by a precise same-path subinterval in the answer. Unknown/outside selections stay visible; every actual answer reference still reaches unchanged provenance/line/hash validation.
regressions.streaming: Identical plain-content/final_answer text is published once, exact prefix extensions publish only their suffix, and distinct text including an unread reference remains intact.
regressions.revision: Direct correction has one revision control with reason/versions/internal details. Only validated completed candidates become primary; failures, truncated candidates, independent human turns and public tool narration retain prior behavior.

//go:build integration
package tui
import (
 "crypto/sha256"
 "database/sql"
 "encoding/json"
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "strings"
 "testing"
 "time"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)
func TestLiveOpcodeSnapshotOverview(t *testing.T) {
 root:=os.Getenv("OPCODE_OVERVIEW_SNAPSHOT")
 require.True(t,filepath.IsAbs(root))
 endpoint,model:="http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1","nemotron-3.5-bolt:e4b"
 prepareLiveOllamaPTY(t,endpoint,model,16384)
 home,data:=t.TempDir(),t.TempDir()
 require.NoError(t,os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(home,".opcode"),0700))
 modelID:="local."+model
 agents:=map[string]any{}
 for _,name:=range []string{"coder","title","summarizer","task"} { agents[name]=map[string]any{"model":modelID} }
 configuration:=map[string]any{"data":map[string]any{"directory":data},"runtime":map[string]any{"mode":"ask"},"tui":map[string]any{"language":"en","sidebar":"hidden"},"security":map[string]any{"sandbox":"bubblewrap"},"providers":map[string]any{"local":map[string]any{"baseURL":endpoint,"api":"ollama"}},"models":map[string]any{modelID:map[string]any{"provider":"local","api_model":model,"api":"ollama","context_window":16384,"default_max_tokens":2048}},"agents":agents,"autoCompact":false}
 raw,err:=json.Marshal(configuration);require.NoError(t,err)
 require.NoError(t,os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(home,".opcode","config.json"),raw,0600))
 h:=newPTYUIHarnessAtSize(t,os.Getenv("OPCODE_EVAL_BINARY"),home,root,180,44,"SSH_CONNECTION=isolated-acceptance")
 h.wait("project initialization choice",30*time.Second,func(frame string)bool{return strings.Contains(frame,"Initialize Project")})
 h.send("n")
 h.wait("Ask ready",10*time.Second,func(frame string)bool{return !strings.Contains(frame,"Initialize Project")&&strings.Contains(ptyUIFooter(frame),"Ask")})
 h.paste("o que pode me falar sobre esse projeto?");h.send("\r")
 h.wait("real Opcode overview",180*time.Second,func(frame string)bool{return strings.Contains(frame,"Opcode")&&strings.Contains(ptyUIFooter(frame),"Completed")&&ptyUIIdleFooter(frame)})
 conn,err:=sql.Open("sqlite3",filepath.Join(data,"opcode.db"));require.NoError(t,err);defer conn.Close()
 history:=ptyUIMessages(conn);answer:=history[len(history)-1].text()
 historyBytes,err:=json.MarshalIndent(history,"","  ");require.NoError(t,err)
 require.NoError(t,os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("OPCODE_OVERVIEW_REPORT")+".history.json",historyBytes,0600))
 require.NoError(t,os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("OPCODE_OVERVIEW_REPORT")+".answer.txt",[]byte(answer),0600))
 require.Contains(t,answer,"Opcode")
 assertPTYOverviewQuality(t,answer)
 paragraphs:=map[string]bool{}
 for _,paragraph:=range strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(answer),"\n\n"){if len(paragraph)>80{require.False(t,paragraphs[paragraph],"overview paragraph repeated");paragraphs[paragraph]=true}}
 require.NotContains(t,h.frame(),"Citations not validated")
 sources:=[]string{}
 for _,msg:=range history{for _,part:=range msg.Parts{if part.Type!="tool_result"{continue};var result struct{Name,Content string;IsError bool `json:"is_error"`};require.NoError(t,json.Unmarshal(part.Data,&result));if result.Name=="view"&&!result.IsError{line,_,_:=strings.Cut(result.Content,"\n");sources=append(sources,line)}}}
 require.Contains(t,sources,`File: "cmd/root.go"`)
 report:=map[string]any{"answer":answer,"sources":sources,"answer_sha256":sha256.Sum256([]byte(answer)),"model":model,"mode":"ask","source":"isolated tracked Opcode snapshot plus working changes","context":16384,"frame":h.frame()}
 encoded,err:=json.MarshalIndent(report,"","  ");require.NoError(t,err)
 require.NoError(t,os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("OPCODE_OVERVIEW_REPORT"),encoded,0600))
 conversationQuit(t,h,true)
}
